label: Saving Versus Investment
finding: Saving versus financial-asset purchases and current capital formation already have distinct applications; retain the adequate instructional range.

label: Private, Public, and National Saving
finding: Saving-component arithmetic is well covered at Hard. Some behavior questions give realized changes while inferring a whole saving-supply shift; distinguish changes at a given rate.

label: Saving and Investment in a Closed Economy
finding: Hard already distinguishes planned imbalance from aggregate accounting. Legendary 43205 incorrectly calls S=I an equilibrium relationship; repair realized versus planned investment and replace recall with reconciliation.

label: Loanable-Funds Equilibrium
finding: Strong Hard disequilibrium applications exist. Upper graph variants repeat them; use actual line geometry for excess supply and reverse inference.

label: Movement Along Versus Shift
finding: Movement versus shift applications are adequate at Hard. Legendary 43245 repeats the Elite technology/rate-offset grammar; integrate a reverse behavioral calculation.

label: Changes in Saving
finding: There is substantial graph coverage, including Hard 43261 separating horizontal shift from equilibrium change. Upper fiscal/graph items should make units and fixed-rate changes explicit and add reconstruction.

label: Investment Demand
finding: Demand determinants, movement along demand, reverse shock diagnosis and partial identification are present. Existing Hard 43269/43275/43281 and upper 43273/43285 are adequate; preserve them.

label: Simultaneous Shifts
finding: Hard already handles opposing rate effects and ambiguous quantity. Legendary 43309 combines unspecified dollar changes with unitless graph movements; use an explicit scale and reverse fiscal reconstruction. Hard 43317 also repeats a one-direction Medium grammar.

label: Government Deficits and Crowding Out
finding: The complete deficit-to-saving-to-rate-to-investment mechanism already appears at Hard. Upper graph 43297 can deepen the distinction between the fiscal shift and final private-saving response.

label: Investment and Capital Formation
finding: Investment versus capital stock and longer-run capital formation are represented. Do not import AD-AS or advanced project valuation.

label: Federal Budget Accounting
finding: Budget arithmetic and borrowing versus revenue are present. Upper 43069/43070 are largely missing-value arithmetic or recognition; strengthen classification and financing reconciliation.

label: Public Saving
finding: 43098 leaves net-tax and interest conventions implicit, so its reconciliation is incomplete. Define gross receipts, transfers, purchases and interest explicitly.

label: Federal Revenues and Outlays
finding: Purchases/transfers and budget categories are covered. Upper 43111 is category recall; distinguish budget growth from current-purchase growth using classified outlays.

label: Deficit Versus Debt
finding: Hard stock/flow and financing-adjustment distinctions are sound. Upper dimensional critique can use a real multi-period financing reconciliation without changing scope.

label: Persistent Deficits and Government Borrowing
finding: Persistent-deficit mechanism is covered. Upper 43156/43158 give broad conditional claims without a substantive constraint; use policy offsets and competing capital-formation evidence.

label: Measures of Federal Debt
finding: Treasury measure definitions, decomposition and comparison boundaries are covered. Preserve useful measure distinctions despite some direct upper items.

label: Debt-to-GDP
finding: Hard ratio calculations and simultaneous numerator/denominator changes are solid. Several Legendary records only subtract ratios; strengthen reverse growth and deficit/ratio reconciliation, with explicit financing assumptions.

label: Interest Costs and Debt Service
finding: Basic interest arithmetic and budget feedback exist. Elite 43145 states only that one rate is a simplification; use an explicitly simplified refinancing portfolio and the resulting budget effect.

label: Real-World Fiscal-Data Interpretation
finding: Source/date/status discipline is represented. 43167 simply repeats the two given projected ratios; strengthen what ratios identify and do not identify. 43162 has a moving last-updated claim that should be removed.
